parameters.query: INSERT INTO coexistence.ia360_meeting_links (token, event_id, contact_number, kind, start_utc, end_utc, summary, zoom_join_url, zoom_meeting_id, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'cal', $4::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz, $6, NULLIF($7, ''), NULLIF($8, '')::bigint, $5::timestamptz + interval '30 days') ON CONFLICT (token) DO NOTHING RETURNING token, event_id, start_utc, end_utc, zoom_meeting_id
